features.text: Static orthotic therapy supports, protects, and positions the elbow
Designed for mild to moderate elbow flexion contractures
Supports maintenance of available elbow range of motion
Provides progressive extension stretching for rehabilitation
Elbow cap provides a controlled 2-point extension stretch
Adjustable single-setting hinge supports changing therapy goals
May be positioned at end range to help maintain extension
Suitable for non-fixed adaptive tissue shortening contractures
Available in Child, Youth, Small, Medium, Large, and X-Large sizes

indications: Mild to moderate elbow flexion contractures
Maintenance of elbow range of motion
measurement: Measure the circumference of the upper and lower arm where the brace cuffs will rest. Compare both measurements with the size chart. Size Upper Arm Circumference Lower Arm Circumference Child 5-7 in. 3.5-6.5 in. Youth 7-10 in. 5-7 in. Small 8-10 in. 7-9 in. Medium 10-12 in. 9-11 in. Large 12-14 in. 11-13 in. X-Large 14-17 in. 13-15 in.
